as_told.title: The Controllers: alien abductions as a smoke screen for MK Ultra

plain: A book called The Controllers, by a writer named Martin Cannon, argues that some alien abductions were faked, and Michels says a man named John B. Alexander "threatened him when he wrote this book." Michels tells this himself and does not say where he heard of the threat. In other tellings he describes the book's contents: Cannon writes about MK Ultra, the CIA's secret mind-control research programme, and a related effort he calls MK-Often, says implants were involved, and suggests the alien abduction story was used "as a smoke screen for MK Ultra." A researcher named Greg Malatzi summarises the book the same way, as being about "the fabrication of alien abductions," without mentioning any threat. If the book is right, some abduction reports would be cover for human experiments, and the threat story would suggest someone did not want that said. The tellers agree on the book's thesis, but only Michels, in one telling, brings up Alexander's threat.
